topics.label: Lecture opening and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture's scope and sets out how the initiation and resolution of inflammation will be explored.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and PRRs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the fundamental concepts of how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue damage while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Toll-like receptor sensing and intracellular signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the localization, ligand recognition, and downstream signaling mechanisms of Toll-like receptors.

topics.label: Cytoplasmic PRRs and inflammasome activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe intracellular pattern recognition receptors and the assembly of the inflammasome complex to mature pro-inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: Inflammatory response coordination, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how activated sentinel cells direct cell recruitment, mediate lymphatic drainage, and can cause systemic complications such as septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the active and passive mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and lead to chronic inflammatory structures like granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic concludes the presentation and announces the subject of the next lecture.
